summary: Sandbach United claimed three points on Saturday with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Stafford Town at The Bach. Tatters netted the decisive goal in the first half, though it came in rather unconventional fashion as the ball bobbled past Stafford keeper Cooper after he made a mess of the save. It was a battling performance from the home side, particularly given they were looking to bounce back from a midweek defeat at Foley Meir. The clean sheet proved crucial as Stafford pressed hard in the second half, with Hall making smart saves to preserve the advantage. Despite Stafford creating more clear-cut chances throughout the match and coming close when they hit the post early on, The Bach's resilience and intensity saw them claim the spoils. The victory keeps Sandbach in the mix near the top of the table as they look to establish themselves as genuine contenders.
